answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The walnut is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the basalt. Reaching the spiral of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
